content:
**Knife Edge** is a location in the Toxic Valley region of Appalachia.

Knife Edge was a post-War Raider camp that was constructed in the northeastern corner of Toxic Valley in Appalachia. It was set up as a base camp for salvaging loot from the Crashed Space Station. [1] 

Knife Edge is a Raider camp located on the northeastern edge of the Toxic Valley. Tents radiate out from a central tower and contain Mattresses, Beds, and assorted junk. The tower itself has a Tinker's Workbench and a Steamer Trunk at its base. The Steamer Trunk is protected by a tripwire which will trigger a Spike Board Trap. There is an Ammo Box, a note, and two Gas Masks at the top of the tower.

There is also a Cooking Station located to the southwest of the lookout tower near a guard post.

Knife Edge appears in *Fallout 76*.
